Sentence (English): I bought a new dishwasher because my old one, which I had used for about five years, broke down, and I really felt how much technology has advanced.
Comments (English): I bought a new dishwasher because my old one, which I had used for about five years, broke down, and I really felt how much technology has advanced. The design is luxurious and matches the kitchen atmosphere well, so overall, I am very satisfied with it. And since it has a Grade 1 rating, you don't have to worry about electricity bills! It is easy to put in large cooking utensils like knives and frying pans, and the efficient internal layout allows me to organize and store dishes much more neatly. Also, the feature that allows you to quickly wash only two compartments by selecting specific areas is really practical. It is great because it saves time, water, and electricity when there aren't many dishes. If I run the low-noise cycle late at night, it is quieter than expected, so I can use it at night without any worries. I am also satisfied with the TrueSteam function. Since it is a high-temperature sterilization wash, I feel safe washing children's dishes or greasy dishes, and it feels like there are fewer water stains left after washing. Thanks to the automatic door opening drying function, drying is much better and I liked that there is less odor. It is convenient to be able to check the wash status and set cycles via the app, and I think a major advantage is the wide range of wash cycles available to suit the situation. The design is luxurious and matches the kitchen atmosphere well, so overall, I am very satisfied with it. And since it has a Grade 1 rating, you don't have to worry about electricity bills! In particular, it actually uses less water than hand washing, so it is quite efficient for households with a lot of dishes. Electricity consumption may increase slightly if you use hot air drying, powerful wash, or True Steam for extended periods. Many people who don't have a dishwasher hesitate about whether to buy one. I highly recommend it to families with children or dual-income couples! It will completely change your quality of life.

Sentence (English): This was an emergency replacement for a much loved and used Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Wish I could give 4.5 stars - great, not perfect ] || ---------------- || This was an emergency replacement for a much loved and used Bosch. I'd had an lg prior to that and liked it too so considered both brands. Looking at specs the LG one won on price for features, as it was hundreds less than a comparable (on paper) Bosch. I will admit in some ways my 10+ year old Bosch was better, but in some ways this one beats. I have owned it now for a week, using it every day. What can I say, I go through a lot of dishes! The good - More spacious inside somehow! Despite being the same overall size as any standard dishwasher, it's impressive how much it holds. especially after adjusting the glass rack down a notch. - Third row rack. I was skeptical about it at first but now I love it. Also holds more than one might expect. It can fit a hand squeeze citrus juicer easily, and all your spatulas and long, flat things. - Automatic door open after the wash cycle to improve the dry cycle . This is a cool feature that maps to what people often end up doing anyway. Thoughtful design touch. - Cleans great - Looks nice - Cute little noises The less good - Noisier at the start compared to my old Bosch. This surprised me a little. Fortunately once it gets going it quiets down - Build quality feels slightly cheaper. Door has less heft, lighter. Maybe a plus for some. - Default cycles seem to take a long time. Maybe I'm misremembering things but 2.5 hours for a normal wash seems like a lot compared to the Bosch. There's an hour cycle that I'm using instead. Haven't found one in the middle yet but there probably is one you can download through the app. - Less forgiving to being interrupted. I used to frequently add items to the Bosch once the cycle started and it handled it elegantly. The LG doesn't automatically restart shortly after the door is open, you have to tell it to go again. I kinda miss this the most, personally.

Since I have a bit of a back problem, I really needed a product that I could put in and take out while standing, rather than the standard cabinet type that most people install. Since there are only two of us, we didn't need a large capacity, so I decided on the 6-place setting, which seems just right. Design and Maintenance: First of all, since it is white, it doesn't stand out anywhere in the kitchen and blends well with the interior, so it looks pretty. Cleaning Power and Usage Tips: The cleaning power is generally good! I found that soaking the dishes in water for a while before washing makes them much cleaner. You need to align similar-shaped dishes to ensure they clean well, so it would be good to keep this in mind beforehand. What I liked about it Automatic Door Opening: It is really convenient that the door opens automatically after washing, so it dries on its own even if I forget to turn it off. Time Saving: I like that the washing time doesn't take that long. Most importantly, I can definitely feel that the time spent standing to wash dishes has decreased. Although it takes up a bit of space, it is much better than having a sore back, so I am truly satisfied. This is one drawback. It is a bit of a shame that I cannot put plastic items in it without worry. I hope a product with these issues improved in the future! Overall Review: I really like it overall, including the size, so I intend to repurchase it! It takes up a little kitchen space, but considering my leg and back pain, I think I made a really good purchase. I recommend it!

One-line summary: Escape the dishwashing hell! A new world of perfect grease removal and automatic door opening. 1. Design and Installation (). True to the Objet line, the colors are really beautiful. It doesn't detract from the kitchen interior; on the contrary, it looks luxurious. I had it installed neatly as a built-in unit, and I am extremely satisfied because it blends well with the sink base cabinets. The technician was also kind and made sure to level it perfectly before leaving. 2. Washing Performance (). My biggest concern was, "Will it really be as clean as hand washing?" but that was a needless worry. Grease Removal: Even a grill used for cooking pork belly or a greasy frying pan comes out squeaky clean. Tornado Wash: Perhaps because the bottom wings spray water in all directions, it doesn't miss dishes in the corners and cleans them thoroughly. High-Temperature Sterilization: Thanks to the 80-degree high-temperature sterilization function, you can worry less about germs as well as grease, so it is safe for households with children or pets. 3. Drying and Convenience (). Automatic Door Opening: This is truly the key feature! Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release internal moisture, so there is no musty smell and drying is much faster. It is so convenient to just run it at night and tidy up in the morning. Noise: It is much quieter than expected. You wouldn't even know it is running if you were watching TV in the living room. It is quiet enough that you don't have to worry about disturbing your neighbors even if you run it late at night. Storage Space: Since it is a 12-place setting, it is great that pots and pans fit inside all at once. With a 3-tier shelf, cutlery can be stored separately on the top shelf, making it efficient. However, fitting large pots requires a bit of 'Tetris' know-how, but you get used to it quickly. Pros: Powerful cleaning power (especially strong on grease). Low-noise design allows for overnight operation. Excellent odor and moisture removal with the automatic door opening function. Pretty design that enhances the kitchen atmosphere. Cons: The wash time of about 1-2 hours may feel a bit long (but it is forgivable since you can rest during that time!). You must purchase dedicated detergent separately.

Sentence (English): We bought this model a couple years ago and it's great -- quiet, cleans well, etc.
Comments (English): [ A couple tips.  ] || ---------------- || We bought this model a couple years ago and it's great -- quiet, cleans well, etc. Good value. Our electricity to the house tends to spike and one time this caused the electronics on the operation panel to falter. The instruction book said to check the circuit breaker, which we did and the circuit breaker had NOT tripped. However, we learned to do a "hard reset" by turning the circuit breaker off and letting it stay off for about 10 minutes. Worked great after that. Also, the service man suggested that instead of using commercial dishwasher cleaners, place two coffee cups filled with vinegar on the diagonal top rack and run the empty dishwasher one cycle. We have hard water and some white residue had built up on the bottom heating coil that the commercial cleaners could not remove. After the vinegar treatment, I gently and easily brushed the residue off with a toothbrush.

What kind of company doesn't test their product before putting it on the market? I can't believe they mass produce this piece of crap and actually put their name on it. Congratulations GE, you have cheapened your product so much, that it has become worthless. It easier to do the task manually. If GE had a rating less than 1, this machine would be there. If GE manufactures jet engines the way they make dishwashers, my flying days are over as well.

Sentence (English): When, not if, you get an H2O error code, use a bottle brush to clean the two horizontal holes/outlets in the bottom of the filter trap at the base of the dishwasher (screw off the main filter, then lift out that flat one to access).
Comments (English): [ H2O error code ] || ---------------- || When, not if, you get an H2O error code, use a bottle brush to clean the two horizontal holes/outlets in the bottom of the filter trap at the base of the dishwasher (screw off the main filter, then lift out that flat one to access). There is a poorly designed sensor in there that constantly gets gunk build up on it. It's likely that it has nothing to do with your water supply line as GE will try to make you believe, so try this easy fix first (it's a common issue, just Google it). If you set your dishwasher to delay start in the middle of the night like I do don't be surprised to be woken up by a warning signal. No other issues with the dishwasher otherwise, but this has been super frustrating to deal with.

Sentence (English): I've had the LG Front Control Dishwasher (LDFN4542D) for a few weeks now, and it is a significant upgrade from my previous unit.
Comments (English): [ Quiet Performance and Great Features. ] || ---------------- || I've had the LG Front Control Dishwasher (LDFN4542D) for a few weeks now, and it is a significant upgrade from my previous unit. It offers a sleek, modern look that fits perfectly in my kitchen, and the Print Proof black stainless steel finish really does help keep smudges away.The best part is how quiet it is. My old dishwasher sounded like a jet taking off, but with this one, I can actually have a conversation in the kitchen while it's running. The third rack is also way more useful than I expected for things like spatulas and large serving spoons.The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is the drying. If you don't use a rinse aid, your dishes is definitely going to stay wet. I've learned to just crack the door for a bit after the cycle ends or use the "Extra Dry" setting, but it's a minor annoyance.Still, it cleans the dishes perfectly, even the crusty stuff, so I'd definitely recommend it if you want something that looks high-end without the crazy price tag.

Sentence (English): The gas detector in my new apartment broke down, and replacing it would cost about 100,000 won.
Comments (English): The gas detector in my new apartment broke down, and replacing it would cost about 100,000 won. On top of that, the built-in oven looked like it hadn't been well-maintained and wasn't in very good condition. Since I happened to have a convection range from my previous home, there was some overlap with that, so after much consideration, I purchased the dishwasher + induction combo because there was a discount. I hadn't used a dishwasher before, so this was my first time using one, and I was surprised at how well it cleaned and performed, much better than I expected. As for the induction cooktop, it is just a standard one, but I really liked that it came as a set so I could use everything neatly.
Comments (Original): 이사한 아파트에 가스감지기가 고장났는데 이것도 교체하려면 10만원 정도 들어가는데다가 빌트인 오븐이 들어가 있는데 관리가 안되서 상태도 별로 안좋아 보이더라구요. 마침 그전 집에서 쓰던 광파오븐레인지가 있는데 중복되는 부분도 있고 해서 이래저래 고민하다가 식세기 + 인덕션 콤보 할인이 있어서 구매했습니다. 식세기는 안쓰다가 이번에 처음 써봤는데 세척이랑 이런게 생각보다 매우 잘 되서 놀라웠고, 인덕션은 그냥 인덕션이긴 한데 셋트로 구성해서 깔끔하게 쓸 수 있으니 너무 좋더라구요.

Sentence (English): The machine washes and functions well, and gets the job done quite well for our family's daily loads (5 stars in that aspect).
Comments (English): [ Functions Great! But warranty aggressively denied ] || ---------------- || The machine washes and functions well, and gets the job done quite well for our family's daily loads (5 stars in that aspect). Although we have a small family and never load the dishwasher to its fullest, the machine always does a good job at cleaning the dishes.However, after 8 months of having the machine, the drain pump stopped working. We had the washer professionally delivered and installed, and I have kept the filter clean while my wife would run the clean cycle about every month, so I'd thought it'd be fair to contact LG for warranty service. Upon reaching a LG representative, I was thrown off guard by how aggressive they would nitpick on details to refuse warranty service! The representative asked me to send them a picture of the setup underneath my sink, and began to nitpick on the small details of why the connections were done wrong and that they would not be offering any help. I then reached out to a local appliance repair company to help me fix the dishwasher and asked them about the drain connections that LG had denied my warranty for; the professional service techs told me that although the connections weren't absolutely perfect, it was still done correctly and they saw no reason that the small details would cause a drainage pump failure.Again, the machine washes and functions very well, but unfortunately our drainage pump failed and LG was very aggressive at nitpicking on the details to deny warranty services.

He will certainly see more. Wish I had bought different brand.

Sentence (English): I just bought a new house and took advantage of HD's Buy More, Save More deal to replace all the kitchen appliances at once.
Comments (English): [ Replacing this as soon as I can afford to ] || ---------------- || I just bought a new house and took advantage of HD's Buy More, Save More deal to replace all the kitchen appliances at once. I loved my LG fridge and microwave in the previous house, so I bought those again; I got a new oven because I wanted to try induction (it's great); and then to round out the deal I bought. this dishwasher. I picked it because it's supposed to be quiet, like the Bosch I left behind at the other house; it has a third rack like the Bosch, and it has a nice low profile with buttons on top and no jutting handle. And in its defense, well, it has the top buttons and the handle.(By the way, to be clear, I'm not talking about an expensive Bosch. It was the lowest-cost one that had a third rack. But it worked, it was fast, it washed and dried the dishes and it was quiet.)Firstly, I swear this thing is 6 inches shorter than the Bosch on the inside. I don't know how that's a thing, but it is. It fits so many fewer dishes. For just my wife and I, I can normally go 3 days or so between full loads. This thing barely fits 2 days of dishes. Again, for 2 people.Even worse, I can't load all 3 racks with what I consider normal-size dishes. If I have normal plates on the bottom and normal glasses in the middle, the glasses catch on the third rack. If I lower the middle rack one level, the water jet on the middle rack can't spin without hitting the plates. So now I have to put glasses in the bottom, and only wash mugs and bowls in the middle.You also can't pull the racks all the way out. The bottom one comes out onto the door, but then when you push it back in it catches on the sides of the rails and gets stuck. You have to manually guide it to the rails to get it to push back in. The middle rack won't even pull out far enough to reach the back, there's always 4-5 inches still inside the dishwasher, so you have to reach deep inside to load the back. Same with the top rack.Once it's running, it's reasonably quiet. until it needs water. Then it makes a noise I can hear upstairs. Considering I watch tv sitting around 10 feet from the dishwasher, that's a problem. The steam function also seems to make loud noises.Oh, speaking of steam (indirectly), if you're buying this because you're looking forward to the 1 hour cycle, temper your expectations. That function allows zero customization, so don't expect to turn the steam on in exchange for a bit of extra time on the cycle. You get 60 minutes or 2+ hours, no in-between. And if you want to run a cycle with all the bells and whistles, get ready for a 5+ hour cycle time. And even after those 5 hours, there's still water droplets on any upward-facing surfaces. Oh, and spots on other surfaces.HD's review app wants me to mention the illumination, so yeah, um, there's a light underneath. For some reason. I assume it's a bit of a flex because they think you'll need an indication that it's running, because it's so quiet. But, um, you'll know. Because it's not. Quiet. Really all the light does is emphasize that the bottom of the door is weirdly high compared to any other dishwasher I've had, like by an inch or more. Which definitely contributes to the space issues I mentioned before. And the light, while not bright, will be enough to impact your movie night if you have an open floor plan. I'm sure there's probably a way to turn it off, but honestly this dishwasher won't be around long enough for me to bother finding out. As soon as my next paycheck shows up this dishwasher will be consigned to the dustbin of history.I'm buying another Bosch.

I loved my LG fridge and microwave in the previous house, so I bought those again; I got a new oven because I wanted to try induction (it's great); and then to round out the deal I bought. this dishwasher. I picked it because it's supposed to be quiet, like the Bosch I left behind at the other house; it has a third rack like the Bosch, and it has a nice low profile with buttons on top and no jutting handle. And in its defense, well, it has the top buttons and the handle.(By the way, to be clear, I'm not talking about an expensive Bosch. It was the lowest-cost one that had a third rack. But it worked, it was fast, it washed and dried the dishes and it was quiet.)Firstly, I swear this thing is 6 inches shorter than the Bosch on the inside. I don't know how that's a thing, but it is. It fits so many fewer dishes. For just my wife and I, I can normally go 3 days or so between full loads. This thing barely fits 2 days of dishes. Again, for 2 people.Even worse, I can't load all 3 racks with what I consider normal-size dishes. If I have normal plates on the bottom and normal glasses in the middle, the glasses catch on the third rack. If I lower the middle rack one level, the water jet on the middle rack can't spin without hitting the plates. So now I have to put glasses in the bottom, and only wash mugs and bowls in the middle.You also can't pull the racks all the way out. The bottom one comes out onto the door, but then when you push it back in it catches on the sides of the rails and gets stuck. You have to manually guide it to the rails to get it to push back in. The middle rack won't even pull out far enough to reach the back, there's always 4-5 inches still inside the dishwasher, so you have to reach deep inside to load the back. Same with the top rack.Once it's running, it's reasonably quiet. until it needs water. Then it makes a noise I can hear upstairs. Considering I watch tv sitting around 10 feet from the dishwasher, that's a problem. The steam function also seems to make loud noises.Oh, speaking of steam (indirectly), if you're buying this because you're looking forward to the 1 hour cycle, temper your expectations. That function allows zero customization, so don't expect to turn the steam on in exchange for a bit of extra time on the cycle. You get 60 minutes or 2+ hours, no in-between. And if you want to run a cycle with all the bells and whistles, get ready for a 5+ hour cycle time. And even after those 5 hours, there's still water droplets on any upward-facing surfaces. Oh, and spots on other surfaces.HD's review app wants me to mention the illumination, so yeah, um, there's a light underneath. For some reason. I assume it's a bit of a flex because they think you'll need an indication that it's running, because it's so quiet. But, um, you'll know. Because it's not. Quiet. Really all the light does is emphasize that the bottom of the door is weirdly high compared to any other dishwasher I've had, like by an inch or more. Which definitely contributes to the space issues I mentioned before. And the light, while not bright, will be enough to impact your movie night if you have an open floor plan. I'm sure there's probably a way to turn it off, but honestly this dishwasher won't be around long enough for me to bother finding out. As soon as my next paycheck shows up this dishwasher will be consigned to the dustbin of history.I'm buying another Bosch.

Comments (English): [ Replacing this as soon as I can afford to ] || ---------------- || I just bought a new house and took advantage of HD's Buy More, Save More deal to replace all the kitchen appliances at once. I loved my LG fridge and microwave in the previous house, so I bought those again; I got a new oven because I wanted to try induction (it's great); and then to round out the deal I bought. this dishwasher. I picked it because it's supposed to be quiet, like the Bosch I left behind at the other house; it has a third rack like the Bosch, and it has a nice low profile with buttons on top and no jutting handle. And in its defense, well, it has the top buttons and the handle.(By the way, to be clear, I'm not talking about an expensive Bosch. It was the lowest-cost one that had a third rack. But it worked, it was fast, it washed and dried the dishes and it was quiet.)Firstly, I swear this thing is 6 inches shorter than the Bosch on the inside. I don't know how that's a thing, but it is. It fits so many fewer dishes. For just my wife and I, I can normally go 3 days or so between full loads. This thing barely fits 2 days of dishes. Again, for 2 people.Even worse, I can't load all 3 racks with what I consider normal-size dishes. If I have normal plates on the bottom and normal glasses in the middle, the glasses catch on the third rack. If I lower the middle rack one level, the water jet on the middle rack can't spin without hitting the plates. So now I have to put glasses in the bottom, and only wash mugs and bowls in the middle.You also can't pull the racks all the way out. The bottom one comes out onto the door, but then when you push it back in it catches on the sides of the rails and gets stuck. You have to manually guide it to the rails to get it to push back in. The middle rack won't even pull out far enough to reach the back, there's always 4-5 inches still inside the dishwasher, so you have to reach deep inside to load the back. Same with the top rack.Once it's running, it's reasonably quiet. until it needs water. Then it makes a noise I can hear upstairs. Considering I watch tv sitting around 10 feet from the dishwasher, that's a problem. The steam function also seems to make loud noises.Oh, speaking of steam (indirectly), if you're buying this because you're looking forward to the 1 hour cycle, temper your expectations. That function allows zero customization, so don't expect to turn the steam on in exchange for a bit of extra time on the cycle. You get 60 minutes or 2+ hours, no in-between. And if you want to run a cycle with all the bells and whistles, get ready for a 5+ hour cycle time. And even after those 5 hours, there's still water droplets on any upward-facing surfaces. Oh, and spots on other surfaces.HD's review app wants me to mention the illumination, so yeah, um, there's a light underneath. For some reason. I assume it's a bit of a flex because they think you'll need an indication that it's running, because it's so quiet. But, um, you'll know. Because it's not. Quiet. Really all the light does is emphasize that the bottom of the door is weirdly high compared to any other dishwasher I've had, like by an inch or more. Which definitely contributes to the space issues I mentioned before. And the light, while not bright, will be enough to impact your movie night if you have an open floor plan. I'm sure there's probably a way to turn it off, but honestly this dishwasher won't be around long enough for me to bother finding out. As soon as my next paycheck shows up this dishwasher will be consigned to the dustbin of history.I'm buying another Bosch.

Sentence (English): I'm reviewing a 500 series model.
Comments (English): [ Overengineered, Frustrating to Use & Under Designed ] || ---------------- || I'm reviewing a 500 series model. I couldn't rate my SHX78b75UC 500 Series - it didn't recognize my model number and 500's were not in drop-down . par for the course with Bosch. I really wanted to love this dishwasher, especially for the high end cost I put out of $1,500, but the reality has been incredibly frustrating. For a product at this price point, the usability—both on the machine itself and in the app—is far more complicated than it should be. ️ Control Panel & Manual – Where the Frustration Started I initially tried to use the dishwasher manually, thinking that would be the most straightforward approach. Unfortunately, that quickly became frustrating. The control panel is not intuitive: There are too many icons and unclear symbols You need the manual just to understand basic functions The manual doesn't help much either: It's not organized in a logical, step-by-step way Instructions for setup and specific features are scattered Example: Setting Water Hardness You must hold a button to enter settings Then repeatedly press to toggle through options Settings are labeled with vague acronyms You have to flip to another section of the manual to decode them By the time you find the right page: The settings screen times out You have to start over If you pass the correct setting: You must cycle through everything again This same issue applies to multiple configurations. App Experience (Tried to Make It Easier… It Didn't) Because the manual and control panel were so difficult, I turned to the app thinking it would simplify things. It didn't. Pairing Issues Pairing is slow and frustrating Took multiple attempts even with: Strong WiFi signal Standing right next to the machine Following directions exactly Total time: 45+ minutes to connect Major Issue: Reconnecting is a Nightmare If the dishwasher loses connection: The app tells you it's disconnected There is no clear way to reconnect You'll see: “Technical Info” → confirms no connection “My Home Appliances” → only option is Remove Appliance The ONLY real way to reconnect is to: Remove the appliance Go through the entire pairing process again That's incredibly frustrating. I spent another 30+ minutes searching the app before having to Google instructions. If I have to Google how to use your app, something is wrong. ❓ Missing or Unclear Feature Instructions I could not easily find how to: Run an express wash Combine it with the advertised CrystalDry system For a machine with so many features, it's surprisingly difficult to actually use them. ️ Interior Design & Capacity The interior layout is also disappointing: Tine configuration limits how dishes fit Looks spacious in the showroom, but isn't efficient in real use I cannot fit dishes for even a 6-person place setting in one load ✅ PROS Extremely quiet operation — so quiet that you often can't tell it's running You actually need to enable a floor light indicator (through the same complex settings) just to know it's on Stainless steel interior (durable, premium feel) Built-in filter system Integrated water softener system (great for hard water areas) App allows you to: Customize wash cycles to your needs Start cycles remotely Schedule washes in advance Receive alerts when: Salt is low Rinse aid is low Errors occur The technology is impressive on paper ❌ CONS Control panel is not user-friendly Manual is poorly organized and not step-by-step Pairing is slow and unreliable Requires multiple attempts even with strong WiFi No clear way to reconnect once disconnected Must remove appliance and re-pair App is not intuitive Key features lack clear instructions Interior layout limits capacity ⚖️ Bottom Line This dishwasher feels overengineered but under-designed from a user experience standpoint. There are genuinely great features here—but they are buried under: Poor usability Frustrating setup Lack of intuitive design If it were easier to use, this could be a fantastic product. As it stands, it's more work than it should be.

I really wanted to love this dishwasher, especially for the high end cost I put out of $1,500, but the reality has been incredibly frustrating. For a product at this price point, the usability—both on the machine itself and in the app—is far more complicated than it should be. ️ Control Panel & Manual – Where the Frustration Started I initially tried to use the dishwasher manually, thinking that would be the most straightforward approach. Unfortunately, that quickly became frustrating. The control panel is not intuitive: There are too many icons and unclear symbols You need the manual just to understand basic functions The manual doesn't help much either: It's not organized in a logical, step-by-step way Instructions for setup and specific features are scattered Example: Setting Water Hardness You must hold a button to enter settings Then repeatedly press to toggle through options Settings are labeled with vague acronyms You have to flip to another section of the manual to decode them By the time you find the right page: The settings screen times out You have to start over If you pass the correct setting: You must cycle through everything again This same issue applies to multiple configurations. App Experience (Tried to Make It Easier… It Didn't) Because the manual and control panel were so difficult, I turned to the app thinking it would simplify things. It didn't. Pairing Issues Pairing is slow and frustrating Took multiple attempts even with: Strong WiFi signal Standing right next to the machine Following directions exactly Total time: 45+ minutes to connect Major Issue: Reconnecting is a Nightmare If the dishwasher loses connection: The app tells you it's disconnected There is no clear way to reconnect You'll see: “Technical Info” → confirms no connection “My Home Appliances” → only option is Remove Appliance The ONLY real way to reconnect is to: Remove the appliance Go through the entire pairing process again That's incredibly frustrating. I spent another 30+ minutes searching the app before having to Google instructions. If I have to Google how to use your app, something is wrong. ❓ Missing or Unclear Feature Instructions I could not easily find how to: Run an express wash Combine it with the advertised CrystalDry system For a machine with so many features, it's surprisingly difficult to actually use them. ️ Interior Design & Capacity The interior layout is also disappointing: Tine configuration limits how dishes fit Looks spacious in the showroom, but isn't efficient in real use I cannot fit dishes for even a 6-person place setting in one load ✅ PROS Extremely quiet operation — so quiet that you often can't tell it's running You actually need to enable a floor light indicator (through the same complex settings) just to know it's on Stainless steel interior (durable, premium feel) Built-in filter system Integrated water softener system (great for hard water areas) App allows you to: Customize wash cycles to your needs Start cycles remotely Schedule washes in advance Receive alerts when: Salt is low Rinse aid is low Errors occur The technology is impressive on paper ❌ CONS Control panel is not user-friendly Manual is poorly organized and not step-by-step Pairing is slow and unreliable Requires multiple attempts even with strong WiFi No clear way to reconnect once disconnected Must remove appliance and re-pair App is not intuitive Key features lack clear instructions Interior layout limits capacity ⚖️ Bottom Line This dishwasher feels overengineered but under-designed from a user experience standpoint. There are genuinely great features here—but they are buried under: Poor usability Frustrating setup Lack of intuitive design If it were easier to use, this could be a fantastic product. As it stands, it's more work than it should be.

Comments (English): [ Comparison review of 3-person and 6-person models without hot air drying ] || ---------------- || Comparison Review of 3-Person vs. 6-Person Models Without Hot Air Drying. Review after using for approximately 3 weeks from installation on April 4th to April 26th (Comparison review of 3-person vs. 6-person models available). Summary: For 1-2 person households, the 6-person model is a must if space allows. Sufficient even without hot air drying / Excellent value for money as the price dropped by about 100,000 won without the drying function; very satisfied. The 6-person model wins hands down in terms of convenience and capacity. However, the 3-person model is sufficient in terms of cleaning power alone. Samsung 6-Person Model Review (Used for the past 3 weeks). Pros (Based on the 6-person model): Ample capacity (Can store a 28cm wok; a pressure cooker seems to fit as well). Even without hot air drying, natural drying works well if the door is left open! Saves on electricity~. Good cleaning power; one bottle of the existing 3-person all-in-one detergent is sufficient. Good basket design; easy to stack and user-friendly. Good details such as a dedicated space for spoons/chopsticks and a small shelf. The single-tier structure makes it ideal for homes with many large dishes. No need for a fine stainless steel mesh basket. Even after the power turns off at the end of the wash cycle, the door does not close completely but remains slightly ajar, making drying and maintenance convenient. Disadvantages (based on the 6-person capacity): . Noise is present (especially loud during drainage). The top is weak, so heavy items cannot be placed on it. Space utilization is lacking. Occasionally, white residue remains (based on using the 3-person all-in-one detergent; suspecting a combination of detergent amount, rinse aid, and stacking issues). Requires drilling for installation (I gave up on the drill-free option as it is a product from a small/medium-sized company). Review of the 3-person MiXX model (used for the past year): Pros (based on the 3-person capacity): . Sufficient cleaning power (no issues using the dedicated all-in-one detergent). Small size reduces the burden of installation space. Most ramen pots fit inside. Features hot air drying and a door opening function. Convenient relocation and installation due to the drill-free design. Disadvantages (based on the 3-person capacity): . Inevitably insufficient capacity; it fills up immediately when pots and pans are placed inside. Inconvenient stacking structure; the dish rack is too high and inefficient. Rarely used the hot air drying function; there is no separate function to turn it off. The door opening mechanism lets out a little heat under stress before closing. Durability issues: Leaks in the same spot twice within 6 months (the refurbished replacement was the same; a structural defect is suspected). After-sales service takes 1-2 weeks, and it is difficult to connect with customer service due to a shortage of staff. Overall review: The washing power of the 3-place setting is sufficient. However, considering capacity, convenience, and after-sales service, the 6-place setting is much more comfortable. The fact that the price dropped without the hot air drying feature is actually an advantage. Occasionally, white residue remains (based on using the 3-person all-in-one detergent; suspecting a combination of detergent amount, rinse aid, and stacking issues). Requires drilling for installation (I gave up on the drill-free option as it is a product from a small/medium-sized company). Review of the 3-person MiXX model (used for the past year): Pros (based on the 3-person capacity): . Sufficient cleaning power (no issues using the dedicated all-in-one detergent). Convenient relocation and installation due to the drill-free design. Disadvantages (based on the 3-person capacity): . Inevitably insufficient capacity; it fills up immediately when pots and pans are placed inside. Inconvenient stacking structure; the dish rack is too high and inefficient. Rarely used the hot air drying function; there is no separate function to turn it off. The door opening mechanism lets out a little heat under stress before closing. Durability issues: Leaks in the same spot twice within 6 months (the refurbished replacement was the same; a structural defect is suspected). Comments (English): [ Comparison review of 3-person and 6-person models without hot air drying ] || ---------------- || Comparison Review of 3-Person vs. 6-Person Models Without Hot Air Drying. Review after using for approximately 3 weeks from installation on April 4th to April 26th (Comparison review of 3-person vs. 6-person models available). Summary: For 1-2 person households, the 6-person model is a must if space allows. Sufficient even without hot air drying / Excellent value for money as the price dropped by about 100,000 won without the drying function; very satisfied. The 6-person model wins hands down in terms of convenience and capacity. However, the 3-person model is sufficient in terms of cleaning power alone. Samsung 6-Person Model Review (Used for the past 3 weeks). Pros (Based on the 6-person model): Ample capacity (Can store a 28cm wok; a pressure cooker seems to fit as well). Even without hot air drying, natural drying works well if the door is left open! Saves on electricity~. Good cleaning power; one bottle of the existing 3-person all-in-one detergent is sufficient. Good basket design; easy to stack and user-friendly. Good details such as a dedicated space for spoons/chopsticks and a small shelf. The single-tier structure makes it ideal for homes with many large dishes. No need for a fine stainless steel mesh basket. Even after the power turns off at the end of the wash cycle, the door does not close completely but remains slightly ajar, making drying and maintenance convenient. Disadvantages (based on the 6-person capacity): . Noise is present (especially loud during drainage). The top is weak, so heavy items cannot be placed on it. Space utilization is lacking. Occasionally, white residue remains (based on using the 3-person all-in-one detergent; suspecting a combination of detergent amount, rinse aid, and stacking issues). Requires drilling for installation (I gave up on the drill-free option as it is a product from a small/medium-sized company). Review of the 3-person MiXX model (used for the past year): Pros (based on the 3-person capacity): . Sufficient cleaning power (no issues using the dedicated all-in-one detergent). Small size reduces the burden of installation space. Most ramen pots fit inside. Features hot air drying and a door opening function. Convenient relocation and installation due to the drill-free design. Disadvantages (based on the 3-person capacity): . Inevitably insufficient capacity; it fills up immediately when pots and pans are placed inside. Inconvenient stacking structure; the dish rack is too high and inefficient. Rarely used the hot air drying function; there is no separate function to turn it off. The door opening mechanism lets out a little heat under stress before closing. Durability issues: Leaks in the same spot twice within 6 months (the refurbished replacement was the same; a structural defect is suspected). After-sales service takes 1-2 weeks, and it is difficult to connect with customer service due to a shortage of staff. Overall review: The washing power of the 3-place setting is sufficient. However, considering capacity, convenience, and after-sales service, the 6-place setting is much more comfortable. The fact that the price dropped without the hot air drying feature is actually an advantage. If space permits, the 6-place setting is recommended for 1-2 person households, while the 12-place setting is better for larger households. If this was helpful, please press the "Helpful" button! Convenient relocation and installation due to the drill-free design. Disadvantages (based on the 3-person capacity): . Inevitably insufficient capacity; it fills up immediately when pots and pans are placed inside. Inconvenient stacking structure; the dish rack is too high and inefficient. Rarely used the hot air drying function; there is no separate function to turn it off. The door opening mechanism lets out a little heat under stress before closing. Durability issues: Leaks in the same spot twice within 6 months (the refurbished replacement was the same; a structural defect is suspected). After-sales service takes 1-2 weeks, and it is difficult to connect with customer service due to a shortage of staff. Overall review: The washing power of the 3-place setting is sufficient. However, considering capacity, convenience, and after-sales service, the 6-place setting is much more comfortable. The fact that the price dropped without the hot air drying feature is actually an advantage. If space permits, the 6-place setting is recommended for 1-2 person households, while the 12-place setting is better for larger households. If this was helpful, please press the "Helpful" button! Sentence (English): Just as having a washing machine and dryer eliminates stress even when laundry piles up like a mountain, the stress of washing dishes has completely disappeared since I got this dishwasher.
Comments (English): "A new world that brought peace to the home! The leisure in life brought about by liberation from dishwashing." 1. Shocking convenience comparable to a washer-dryer! Just as having a washing machine and dryer eliminates stress even when laundry piles up like a mountain, the stress of washing dishes has completely disappeared since I got this dishwasher. In the past, seeing the pile of dishes after cooking used to make me sigh, but now I can just enjoy cooking and leave the cleanup to Samsung Bespoke, so I am truly happy. It is a choice I have no regrets about—to the point where I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. 2. Peace of mind even when running at night! Quieter than a dryer. What surprised me most was its quietness. Personally, I feel it sounds even quieter than a dryer in operation. Since there is almost no noise, running it before bed does not disturb my sleep at all, and if I start it before going out, I can cook immediately with clean dishes when I return home, making my workflow incredibly efficient. 3. Ample storage for 6 people and simple usage. Since it is a countertop model for 6 people, you might feel a bit short on space if you put in large pots or frying pans (**I avoid using non-stick products because I'm worried about the coating weakening). However, for someone like me who uses the dishwasher frequently and wants to lighten the burden of washing dishes after every meal, it is incredibly useful and has a sufficient capacity. Using it is also really simple; you just toss in a single mini solid detergent packet and you're done. It feels like I'm doing housework without lifting a finger. Just a quick note! A helpful tip for perfect drying. Let me tell you the most important point when using the dishwasher! The key is to place dishes or cups at a slight tilt to prevent water from pooling on top, and arrange them so they do not overlap. If you just place them flat, water can pool in the concave top section, hindering drying, but if you pay a little attention and stand them at an angle, they will come out perfectly dry and fluffy! Also, dishes must not overlap to ensure a thorough cleaning. 4. The number one contributor to 'household peace,' eliminating the need to ask your husband to help with the dishes. I really love that I don't have to ask my husband to do the dishes, and we don't have to feel awkward around each other. Since both my husband and I have become so much more comfortable with each other, we feel much more relaxed. I believe this is a more valuable investment than any other appliance for dual-income couples or those who enjoy cooking. Overall review: "Leave the dishwashing to the machine and spend your precious time with your family! I sincerely highly recommend it." Comments (English): "A new world that brought peace to the home! The leisure in life brought about by liberation from dishwashing." 1. Shocking convenience comparable to a washer-dryer! Just as having a washing machine and dryer eliminates stress even when laundry piles up like a mountain, the stress of washing dishes has completely disappeared since I got this dishwasher. In the past, seeing the pile of dishes after cooking used to make me sigh, but now I can just enjoy cooking and leave the cleanup to Samsung Bespoke, so I am truly happy. It is a choice I have no regrets about—to the point where I wonder why I didn't get it sooner. 2. Peace of mind even when running at night! Quieter than a dryer. What surprised me most was its quietness. Personally, I feel it sounds even quieter than a dryer in operation. Ample storage for 6 people and simple usage. Since it is a countertop model for 6 people, you might feel a bit short on space if you put in large pots or frying pans (**I avoid using non-stick products because I'm worried about the coating weakening). However, for someone like me who uses the dishwasher frequently and wants to lighten the burden of washing dishes after every meal, it is incredibly useful and has a sufficient capacity. Using it is also really simple; you just toss in a single mini solid detergent packet and you're done. It feels like I'm doing housework without lifting a finger. Just a quick note! A helpful tip for perfect drying. Let me tell you the most important point when using the dishwasher! The key is to place dishes or cups at a slight tilt to prevent water from pooling on top, and arrange them so they do not overlap. If you just place them flat, water can pool in the concave top section, hindering drying, but if you pay a little attention and stand them at an angle, they will come out perfectly dry and fluffy! Sentence (English): We really want to love this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quiet but the racks suck! ] || ---------------- || We really want to love this dishwasher. Like, we were emotionally prepared to write it a thank-you note. But alas… it has a personality.Let's start with the good: this thing is so quiet it's borderline suspicious. I've checked on it multiple times just to make sure it didn't quietly quit mid-cycle. The little end-of-cycle chime? Adorable. Very “I did my best, hope you're proud of me.” It also looks sleek, modern, and somehow manages to repel fingerprints like it's got trust issues. Respect.Now… the chaos.The racks appear to have been designed by someone who has only ever seen dishes in theory. Standard dinner plates? Sure. Anything else—pasta bowls, serving dishes, your will to live? Good luck. It's like playing a very frustrating game of Tetris where none of the pieces fit and you're not allowed to rotate them.And then… the bottom rack sliders. I don't say this lightly: this is a villain origin story. If you so much as look at the bottom rack wrong, it jumps the track like it's trying to escape. Load one slightly ambitious item? Off the rails. Literally. It's maddening. We came this close to returning it and starting over with something less… dramatic.The top rack? Not innocent. Not helpful. Just watching the chaos unfold.

Sentence (English): This purchase was to replace a Bosch dishwasher that we have had for about 14 years.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, but .  ] || ---------------- || This purchase was to replace a Bosch dishwasher that we have had for about 14 years. We liked the first Bosch dishwasher and bought a very similar model as a replacement. I installed both the first one and the new one. The first one was very easy to install, but Bosch has changed the design of the new models which made for extra work during the installation of the new machine. Our first one was hard-wired whereas the new one comes with a plug that requires an outlet installed. Not a problem if you have planned for that during original construction, but that made for extra work for me during the install. The drain tube and water supply routing also has been changed which required cutting a larger hole in the cabinate. Again, not a problem, just took additional time. The dishwasher itself works fine and is very quiet, which is why we bought Bosch again.

Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. A small revolution in the kitchen! A review of the Samsung dishwasher: compact yet perfect in performance. [Performance and Ease of Use] I purchased this to escape the stress of washing dishes, and the cleaning power is truly stronger than I expected! I was surprised to see even burnt-on food and greasy dishes come out squeaky clean. The controls are intuitive, making it convenient enough for parents or children to use easily, and thanks to the automatic door opening function, drying is completed neatly, ensuring hygiene. [Size and Design] I was worried because my kitchen countertop isn't very wide, but this product is just the right size. As shown in the photo, it fits perfectly into the corner space, maximizing space utilization. Since it is a countertop model, there is no hassle with installation, and the luxurious glass material has brightened up the kitchen atmosphere. I am also very satisfied that the material resists fingerprints, so it stays clean without needing to wipe it every time. [Delivery and Installation Service] True to Samsung's style, the installation service is a perfect 100 out of 100. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the drain pipe connection was handled very meticulously, ensuring there were no leaks. I was truly touched that after installation, they even personally ran a test run and kindly explained maintenance tips and how to use the dedicated detergent. [Overall Review]. It is a product that improves my quality of life to the point where I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. It is perfect in every aspect, from cleaning performance and design to service. I highly recommend it, especially to 1-2 person households or those looking to maximize kitchen space efficiency!

Comments (English): [ I finally bought a dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || It cleans well and my wife likes it, but since I tend to do the dishes myself, I'm not sure what makes it so good. First of all, it's a 12-place setting model, but if there are only about 3 or 4 dishes to wash, it feels like a waste to use the dishwasher. So, if we eat three meals a day, we have to gather everything up to wash, which means the dishes end up piling up. I think it would be useful for households that eat only one meal or have a lot of dishes to wash, considering the electricity and water savings involved in washing small amounts. If there are only one to three people or not a lot of dishes, I recommend a shelf-mounted dishwasher over a built-in one. It's easier to install and more comfortable to work with while standing. However, with built-in models, installation is tricky if you have food waste, and you have to bend over to work. While this is good for large loads, I recommend a shelf-mounted one otherwise.

Sentence (English): Product Name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Hot Air Dryer Dishwasher (14 Places) User Review: .
Comments (English): [ A dishwasher that every housewife needs ] || ---------------- || Product Name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE AI Built-in Hot Air Dryer Dishwasher (14 Places) User Review: . These days, doing the dishes is surprisingly a huge chore when you're doing housework. I was also worried about the dishes piling up every day. My father-in-law gave me some pocket money to buy a dishwasher because he said my daughter-in-law was working too hard, so I finally decided to get one. I thought that since I was buying one anyway, I should get a good one, so after researching, I decided on the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in model. The first impression I got after it was installed was that it looked neat. The white tone makes the kitchen look much brighter, and since it's built-in, it takes up almost no space. I did consider the latest model with features like automatic door opening and voice activation. Honestly, even with those features, I felt like I would end up opening it manually anyway, and I was also worried about it breaking. So, I chose a model with only the essential functions, and I think that was a really good choice. At first, I wondered if the hot air drying feature was really that good, but after using it, it's completely different. I thought it would just be a regular dryer, but when I actually ran it, the dishes finished fluffy and dry with almost no water left. To be honest, this is the most satisfying part. The interior is really spacious, so there is plenty of room even when putting in multiple pots. It has a separate cutlery holder and even a wine glass holder, so organizing is easy. After using it for a few days, my daily life has definitely changed. It’s so convenient because even if dishes pile up after dinner, I just put them in and run it, and that’s it. If you use a lot of Samsung products at home, you can connect it via SmartThings to check the remaining time and start the wash on your phone, which is surprisingly convenient. It’s a feature you’ll keep using once you try it. One drawback: There is no interior light, so it feels a bit dark inside at night. However, you don't really need a light anyway, and since you remove the basket to put dishes away, it doesn't seem to matter. You should keep in mind that if you don't prepare detergent or rinse aid in advance, you can't use it right away. User Review: I am extremely satisfied. I am the type of person who pre-washes, scrubs with a first scrubber, and then scrubs again with a rinsing scrubber. Although we are a family of three and don't have many dishes, washing takes a long time, and I don't tend to let them pile up. I spent over a year debating between the 14-place, 12-place, or 6-place models before finally purchasing this one. First of all, the 6-person capacity is great. My kitchen doesn't have many base cabinets, so I wasn't keen on a built-in model and went with the 6-person size. Since I have back issues, having it on the countertop is really comfortable. Because I pre-wash the clothes before putting them in, they get really clean. When I open it up afterward, they feel warm and sanitized. Even without a dishwasher, I use three types of sponges—a disposable sponge, a first-stage sponge, and a second-stage rinse sponge—so this dishwasher plays a huge role and is incredibly convenient for me. After using it, I think for those like me who pre-wash without food scraps, the "Quick" setting is sufficient, even without the "Standard" setting. After installing it, I ran the Standard setting once and then the Quick setting, and I pretty much figured out how to use it. Before buying, I visited a store and debated a lot about models with hot air drying. However, when you open it up after a run, it finishes with warm water, so if you wipe and tidy up right away, it dries quickly. I saw a review from someone who had used a dishwasher for a long time saying that the hot air drying wasn't really necessary. I just bought it based on that review. I thought about it for a long time and even went to the store to check it out before purchasing, but I think I will use it very well. I saw some reviews saying it is loud, but not at all. Sentence (English): Using a bottle washer doesn't help your wrists at all.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher last year and I went to clean the filter as advised in the owners manual only to find significant rust in the stainless steel pan under the filter cover.
Comments (English): [ Worst customer service and warranty response system ever. ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher last year and I went to clean the filter as advised in the owners manual only to find significant rust in the stainless steel pan under the filter cover. I called Bosch about it as it is still under warranty and they dispatched a contracted technician to inspect it. He found even more rust so he called Bosch and a technician told him there was nothing they could do, it must be caused by hard water or an introduced corrosive agent, and to just wipe or scrape the rust off and use rinse aid. Obviously rust does not simply wipe or scrape off and several spots cannot be reached. Nothing corrosive has ever been put in the machine and only their recommended detergent and rinse aid has been used. The contract technician agreed that their assessment was incorrect so I disputed their claims as instructed by Bosch. I waited a month or more, called 5 times when I got no response, was told repeatedly that someone would call within 24-48 hours, but nobody ever called and I never got any written response to my dispute. I finally filed a complaint with Better Business Bureau which finally resulted in a response from Bosch but it was the same stupid advice to just wipe the rust off. They also stated that if it was a manufacturing defect it would have been visible when it was new! Again, obviously when it was new there hadn't been any water run through it, and it would not have been visible due to the filter/drain cover. I have rejected their preposterous claims through BBB. Bottom line is Bosch's customer support is the worst. They repeatedly lie to you telling you someone will call but nobody ever does, ignore their own dispute process, rely on a company technician that never sees your machine, and ignores the assessment of the contract technician that has actually inspected it. Don't buy Bosch!

Sentence (English): Taking this experience as an opportunity, I have decided to abandon the idea that all electronics are LG.
Comments (English): The service and guidance are terrible. Taking this experience as an opportunity, I have decided to abandon the idea that all electronics are LG. Honestly, I was upset when the coating on my refrigerator peeled off while using LG appliances, but since a year had passed and the paint was chipping over time, I decided to put up with it, thinking that as long as the performance was good, that was enough. However, this dishwasher is truly the worst. First, the energy efficiency rating was attached to a protective film, which made me doubt whether it was a genuine product. I only learned about the protective film after the incident occurred. There was absolutely no prior notice. I was told that dishwashers have a special protective film attached and are meant to be used without removing it. Second, although the installer denies it, the service technician claims that the scratches shown in the photo are not a product defect but rather caused by interference because the installer installed the baseboard too tightly. He says that is why the paint on the right and left sides of the door got scratched and peeled off. If that is the case, is it possible for interference to occur only on the door? The service technician was absolutely certain that the interference occurred only on the door. In that case, are we supposed to share the burden with the customer for this accident caused by the installer's fault? Is it the proper after-sales service behavior of global LG to share the burden with the customer for a technician's fault that occurred just five days after installation? I only received a one-year warranty extension and had the door replaced. May you get rich like that. I am extremely disappointed with LG's after-sales service. I'm done with it, too. I don't need any of that anymore. My heart has completely left the brand. If anyone around me tries to buy an LG Electronics product, they will likely be pushed back. LG isn't the only brand for home appliances. I believe it is LG's clear fault to reduce a product to a repaired unit instead of replacing the main unit, when the issue arose due to the technician's error just five days after installation. Whether I am the only one who thinks this way is up to the consumer to judge, isn't it?

Sentence (English): I don't need any of that anymore.
Comments (English): The service and guidance are terrible. Taking this experience as an opportunity, I have decided to abandon the idea that all electronics are LG. Honestly, I was upset when the coating on my refrigerator peeled off while using LG appliances, but since a year had passed and the paint was chipping over time, I decided to put up with it, thinking that as long as the performance was good, that was enough. However, this dishwasher is truly the worst. First, the energy efficiency rating was attached to a protective film, which made me doubt whether it was a genuine product. I only learned about the protective film after the incident occurred. There was absolutely no prior notice. I was told that dishwashers have a special protective film attached and are meant to be used without removing it. Second, although the installer denies it, the service technician claims that the scratches shown in the photo are not a product defect but rather caused by interference because the installer installed the baseboard too tightly. He says that is why the paint on the right and left sides of the door got scratched and peeled off. If that is the case, is it possible for interference to occur only on the door? The service technician was absolutely certain that the interference occurred only on the door. In that case, are we supposed to share the burden with the customer for this accident caused by the installer's fault? Is it the proper after-sales service behavior of global LG to share the burden with the customer for a technician's fault that occurred just five days after installation? I only received a one-year warranty extension and had the door replaced. May you get rich like that. I am extremely disappointed with LG's after-sales service. I'm done with it, too. I don't need any of that anymore. My heart has completely left the brand. If anyone around me tries to buy an LG Electronics product, they will likely be pushed back. LG isn't the only brand for home appliances. I believe it is LG's clear fault to reduce a product to a repaired unit instead of replacing the main unit, when the issue arose due to the technician's error just five days after installation. Whether I am the only one who thinks this way is up to the consumer to judge, isn't it?

Sentence (English): LG isn't the only brand for home appliances.
Comments (English): The service and guidance are terrible. Taking this experience as an opportunity, I have decided to abandon the idea that all electronics are LG. Honestly, I was upset when the coating on my refrigerator peeled off while using LG appliances, but since a year had passed and the paint was chipping over time, I decided to put up with it, thinking that as long as the performance was good, that was enough. However, this dishwasher is truly the worst. First, the energy efficiency rating was attached to a protective film, which made me doubt whether it was a genuine product. I only learned about the protective film after the incident occurred. There was absolutely no prior notice. I was told that dishwashers have a special protective film attached and are meant to be used without removing it. Second, although the installer denies it, the service technician claims that the scratches shown in the photo are not a product defect but rather caused by interference because the installer installed the baseboard too tightly. He says that is why the paint on the right and left sides of the door got scratched and peeled off. If that is the case, is it possible for interference to occur only on the door? The service technician was absolutely certain that the interference occurred only on the door. In that case, are we supposed to share the burden with the customer for this accident caused by the installer's fault? Is it the proper after-sales service behavior of global LG to share the burden with the customer for a technician's fault that occurred just five days after installation? I only received a one-year warranty extension and had the door replaced. May you get rich like that. I am extremely disappointed with LG's after-sales service. I'm done with it, too. I don't need any of that anymore. My heart has completely left the brand. If anyone around me tries to buy an LG Electronics product, they will likely be pushed back. LG isn't the only brand for home appliances. I believe it is LG's clear fault to reduce a product to a repaired unit instead of replacing the main unit, when the issue arose due to the technician's error just five days after installation. Whether I am the only one who thinks this way is up to the consumer to judge, isn't it?

Sentence (English): I had this dishwasher installed 10 days ago, and I honestly never thought I could hate an appliance this much.
Comments (English): [ I HATE THIS DISHWASHER ] || ---------------- || I had this dishwasher installed 10 days ago, and I honestly never thought I could hate an appliance this much. We purchased this make and model to replace our old KitchenAid panel‑ready dishwasher. We were told it was “exactly the same” as our previous model, but that is simply not true. The racks are significantly smaller and do not pull out all the way, making it very awkward to load dishes and glasses toward the back. The bottom rack is especially poorly designed. It holds only five dinner plates—five. The remaining plate dividers (tines) are too short to properly support dinner plates, causing them to lean into each other. During the wash cycle, they rattle together and chip. The rack itself is too narrow to place dinner plates side by side. As a result, you are forced to waste half the rack just to load a single row of plates. Because of this terrible capacity, as a family of three we are now running the dishwasher twice every day. Each cycle takes about three hours, meaning this machine runs for six hours daily—every single day. After lunch, I can load our three breakfast plates and two lunch plates, but one plate must be left sitting in the sink because there's no room. After dinner, I unload the machine and reload it with the leftover lunch plate, our three dinner plates, and three salad plates, then run it again. In the morning, I unload it and repeat the entire process. Every day. To make matters worse, this machine uses a Door Open Dry system. At the end of the cycle, the door automatically pops open and releases hot steam. If you turn this feature off, everything inside remains soaking wet. Between the poor rack design, extremely limited capacity, and inconvenient drying system, this dishwasher has been a huge downgrade from our previous KitchenAid. I regret this purchase deeply and would not recommend this model to anyone, especially families.

Other than that, I would definitely recommend.

Sentence (English): Everyone around me said a dishwasher was a must, but I never really felt the need for one.
Comments (English): [ What would I have done without the dishwasher lady? ] || ---------------- || Everyone around me said a dishwasher was a must, but I never really felt the need for one. However, when I moved into my new home, there was a space left over from the previous tenants who had removed their dishwasher, so I decided to take this opportunity to buy one. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder what I would have done if I hadn't bought it! - Smart AI Mode. While there are various features, the one I use most efficiently is the AI Custom Wash+ mode. It automatically cleans based on the level of soiling on the dishes, which is incredibly convenient. It uses advanced sensors to detect dirt levels and adjusts the cleaning accordingly, making it efficient for today's busy world! It performs a pre-wash, followed by a main wash with the appropriate time and water temperature based on the soil level. Then, an AI algorithm analyzes the dirt to determine the number of rinses. Once finished, the door automatically opens slightly to allow for drying! - Thorough and Powerful Cleaning. The moving washing blades at the bottom, which rotate in both directions, and the upper washing blades create a 4-stage three-dimensional water jet to powerfully clean every nook and cranny, including large surfaces and concave dishes. Furthermore, you can rest assured knowing that the high-temperature direct water sterilizes harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation, and the powerful drying feature is a great advantage! I heard that wine glasses can be used as long as they aren't extremely thin, so I tried putting them in, and they were cleaned perfectly! Wine glasses and concave drinking glasses are really hard to clean, so I am satisfied. - Night Course and Economy Mode. Thanks to safe double soundproofing material, it is low-noise, so it isn't very loud even during normal use. If you get close, you can only hear the trickling sound of water. It is especially quiet at night if you run it on the low-noise night course. The door opens automatically when finished, so it is so convenient to just leave it running while you sleep! If you install the app and connect it, you can set the AI economy mode to monitor the system while maintaining cleaning power. You can check electricity usage, and since it functions as a remote control, you can set it up using your phone! - Interior Effect. The white color blends in well wherever you place it and looks neat! Since it is an all-in-one panel type, it is installed custom-fitted without any clutter, and my sink area looks much brighter now. Before installation, the technician visited to check everything thoroughly before bringing it over and setting it up! I bought it without high expectations, but I am using it with satisfaction that exceeds my expectations.

Comments (English): [ What would I have done without the dishwasher lady? ] || ---------------- || Everyone around me said a dishwasher was a must, but I never really felt the need for one. However, when I moved into my new home, there was a space left over from the previous tenants who had removed their dishwasher, so I decided to take this opportunity to buy one. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder what I would have done if I hadn't bought it! - Smart AI Mode. While there are various features, the one I use most efficiently is the AI Custom Wash+ mode. It automatically cleans based on the level of soiling on the dishes, which is incredibly convenient. It uses advanced sensors to detect dirt levels and adjusts the cleaning accordingly, making it efficient for today's busy world! It performs a pre-wash, followed by a main wash with the appropriate time and water temperature based on the soil level. Then, an AI algorithm analyzes the dirt to determine the number of rinses. Once finished, the door automatically opens slightly to allow for drying! - Thorough and Powerful Cleaning. The moving washing blades at the bottom, which rotate in both directions, and the upper washing blades create a 4-stage three-dimensional water jet to powerfully clean every nook and cranny, including large surfaces and concave dishes. Furthermore, you can rest assured knowing that the high-temperature direct water sterilizes harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation, and the powerful drying feature is a great advantage! I heard that wine glasses can be used as long as they aren't extremely thin, so I tried putting them in, and they were cleaned perfectly! Wine glasses and concave drinking glasses are really hard to clean, so I am satisfied. - Night Course and Economy Mode. Thanks to safe double soundproofing material, it is low-noise, so it isn't very loud even during normal use. If you get close, you can only hear the trickling sound of water. It is especially quiet at night if you run it on the low-noise night course. The door opens automatically when finished, so it is so convenient to just leave it running while you sleep! If you install the app and connect it, you can set the AI economy mode to monitor the system while maintaining cleaning power. You can check electricity usage, and since it functions as a remote control, you can set it up using your phone! - Interior Effect. The white color blends in well wherever you place it and looks neat! Since it is an all-in-one panel type, it is installed custom-fitted without any clutter, and my sink area looks much brighter now. Before installation, the technician visited to check everything thoroughly before bringing it over and setting it up! I bought it without high expectations, but I am using it with satisfaction that exceeds my expectations.

If you install the app and connect it, you can set the AI economy mode to monitor the system while maintaining cleaning power. You can check electricity usage, and since it functions as a remote control, you can set it up using your phone! - Interior Effect. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder what I would have done if I hadn't bought it! - Smart AI Mode. While there are various features, the one I use most efficiently is the AI Custom Wash+ mode. It automatically cleans based on the level of soiling on the dishes, which is incredibly convenient. It uses advanced sensors to detect dirt levels and adjusts the cleaning accordingly, making it efficient for today's busy world! It performs a pre-wash, followed by a main wash with the appropriate time and water temperature based on the soil level. Then, an AI algorithm analyzes the dirt to determine the number of rinses. Once finished, the door automatically opens slightly to allow for drying! - Thorough and Powerful Cleaning. The moving washing blades at the bottom, which rotate in both directions, and the upper washing blades create a 4-stage three-dimensional water jet to powerfully clean every nook and cranny, including large surfaces and concave dishes. Furthermore, you can rest assured knowing that the high-temperature direct water sterilizes harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation, and the powerful drying feature is a great advantage! I heard that wine glasses can be used as long as they aren't extremely thin, so I tried putting them in, and they were cleaned perfectly! Wine glasses and concave drinking glasses are really hard to clean, so I am satisfied. - Night Course and Economy Mode. Thanks to safe double soundproofing material, it is low-noise, so it isn't very loud even during normal use. If you get close, you can only hear the trickling sound of water. It is especially quiet at night if you run it on the low-noise night course. The door opens automatically when finished, so it is so convenient to just leave it running while you sleep! If you install the app and connect it, you can set the AI economy mode to monitor the system while maintaining cleaning power. You can check electricity usage, and since it functions as a remote control, you can set it up using your phone! - Interior Effect. The white color blends in well wherever you place it and looks neat! Since it is an all-in-one panel type, it is installed custom-fitted without any clutter, and my sink area looks much brighter now. Before installation, the technician visited to check everything thoroughly before bringing it over and setting it up! I bought it without high expectations, but I am using it with satisfaction that exceeds my expectations.

Furthermore, you can rest assured knowing that the high-temperature direct water sterilizes harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation, and the powerful drying feature is a great advantage! I heard that wine glasses can be used as long as they aren't extremely thin, so I tried putting them in, and they were cleaned perfectly! Wine glasses and concave drinking glasses are really hard to clean, so I am satisfied. - Night Course and Economy Mode. Thanks to safe double soundproofing material, it is low-noise, so it isn't very loud even during normal use. If you get close, you can only hear the trickling sound of water. It is especially quiet at night if you run it on the low-noise night course. The door opens automatically when finished, so it is so convenient to just leave it running while you sleep!
