Comments (English): [ What would I have done without the dishwasher lady? ] || ---------------- || Everyone around me said a dishwasher was a must, but I never really felt the need for one. However, when I moved into my new home, there was a space left over from the previous tenants who had removed their dishwasher, so I decided to take this opportunity to buy one. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder what I would have done if I hadn't bought it! - Smart AI Mode. While there are various features, the one I use most efficiently is the AI Custom Wash+ mode. It automatically cleans based on the level of soiling on the dishes, which is incredibly convenient. It uses advanced sensors to detect dirt levels and adjusts the cleaning accordingly, making it efficient for today's busy world! It performs a pre-wash, followed by a main wash with the appropriate time and water temperature based on the soil level. Then, an AI algorithm analyzes the dirt to determine the number of rinses. Once finished, the door automatically opens slightly to allow for drying! - Thorough and Powerful Cleaning. The moving washing blades at the bottom, which rotate in both directions, and the upper washing blades create a 4-stage three-dimensional water jet to powerfully clean every nook and cranny, including large surfaces and concave dishes. Furthermore, you can rest assured knowing that the high-temperature direct water sterilizes harmful bacteria without worrying about plastic deformation, and the powerful drying feature is a great advantage! I heard that wine glasses can be used as long as they aren't extremely thin, so I tried putting them in, and they were cleaned perfectly! Wine glasses and concave drinking glasses are really hard to clean, so I am satisfied. - Night Course and Economy Mode. Thanks to safe double soundproofing material, it is low-noise, so it isn't very loud even during normal use. If you get close, you can only hear the trickling sound of water. It is especially quiet at night if you run it on the low-noise night course. The door opens automatically when finished, so it is so convenient to just leave it running while you sleep! If you install the app and connect it, you can set the AI economy mode to monitor the system while maintaining cleaning power. You can check electricity usage, and since it functions as a remote control, you can set it up using your phone! - Interior Effect. The white color blends in well wherever you place it and looks neat! Since it is an all-in-one panel type, it is installed custom-fitted without any clutter, and my sink area looks much brighter now. Sentence (English): BUYER BEWARE!
Comments (English): [ BUYER BEWARE! BUYER BEWARE! BUYER BEWARE!  ] || ---------------- || BUYER BEWARE! I purchased this Costco Maytag dishwasher and also a stove. I was aware that the dishwasher was a separate install. The dishwasher installer finally shows up who was suppose to be here between 12 and 3:00pm, he shows up at 6:45 pm. Said he had a rough day. Okay, he walks in and says this isn't a standard install. We have four small drawers between the existing working dishwasher and the sink and tells us it's going to be $270.00! When Costco advertises with their dishwashers ads that it's a free install. Costco doesn't mention anything about IF ITS ONLY AN STANDARD INSTALLATION. ( I'm Sure it doesn't matter what dishwasher it is ) We had guests arriving so I told the installer that I needed to take this up with Costco. Later that evening I get a call from a Costco Logistics person. I explained. He offers $120.00 and we would still get stuck with a $150.00 installation fee. This person lead me to believe he would offer more if we didn't deal with their installer. After talking to this logistics person I had up to 5 to 6 more calls from other logistics and Costco personnel having to repeat this problem. You would think to avoid all of these phone calls that Costco would put one person per situation/complaint so it isn't 6 to 7 redundant phone calls. Finally out of frustration we accepted the $120 and decided we did not want their installer. He wanted to replace the hot water valve when he couldn't turn it off. My husband bent down and turned it off. He wanted $170 for parts which were excessive. We checked the next day. Then he wanted $100 for labor. Once my husband and I had a chance to talk the next day, we weren't sure we felt comfortable with this installer when he couldn't even turn the hot water valve off. Today we still have the dishwasher sitting in our dining room. We will eventually get it installed. To end this, I also want to say that the installers called after all the Costco phone calls thinking we were done with this sorry issue to say they were coming out to do the install. What? I had to be the one to cancel the install date I never set up. All of these logistics people couldn't even take the time to let the installers know that they had been canceled. I the customer had to do it. This whole mess was a huge disappointment by a dissatisfied Costco customer. BUYER BEWARE!

I also wanted a dishwasher with height adjustable drawers as every wash isn't necessarily the same. There are a variety of different cycles depending upon your load. All in all, I am very happy so far.

Sentence (English): I really don't understand anyone who would think having to use an app to control their dishwasher would be a good idea.
Comments (English): [ Junk. Do not buy. ] || ---------------- || I really don't understand anyone who would think having to use an app to control their dishwasher would be a good idea. Need to do a quick rinse cycle? You're gonna have to open the app on your phone, give it a minute to connect to the washer, then have it try to sell you some cleaning products, and then you can ask it to perform a rinse cycle. Want to delay the start time so you can have the washer run during off peak electrical hours? Better open the app and program it that way. Oh, and then you'll wake up to find out the cycle never started. My 20 year old GE washer was able to do all of this without the use of an app. It worked just fine. I can't believe they have turned kitchen appliances into marketing devices. Also, I have yet to witness the door opening after a cycle to allow the dishes to air dry. The door makes a very cheap sounding "click" when closing or opening. It certainly makes you question the quality or durability of this product. Oh, and they give you the smallest size container for silverware. Want more capacity? Thats going to be another $30 for a Bosch part. Good riddance.

Comments (English): [ It improves the quality of life. ] || ---------------- || [Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-Place Model Review]. Motivation for Purchase. Although I don't usually have a huge amount of dishes to wash, clearing the dishes generated after every meal was quite a hassle. Lately, especially due to a herniated disc, I found myself leaving dishes unwashed and letting them pile up in the kitchen. That is why I started considering a dishwasher, and I regret not buying it sooner. I was hesitant about getting a built-in model because it would require changing the kitchen layout, so I ended up choosing a countertop model that offers excellent space utilization. In particular, the clean white design seemed to match the atmosphere of my kitchen well, so I decided on Samsung BESPOKE, a brand I trust! User Review (Design and Size). Appearance: As expected of BESPOKE, the design is truly luxurious and beautiful. The matte white color makes the kitchen look much brighter. Size: When I first received it, I felt it was bulkier than I expected, but once installed, I actually liked it because the interior space was ample since it is a 6-place model. It is large enough to fit large pots and pans if you maneuver them around. Performance and Cleaning Power. Cleaning Power: It cleans incredibly well, exceeding my expectations! Perhaps thanks to the high-temperature wash, even greasy dishes finish squeaky clean, and I feel reassured using it because it feels like it's even sterilizing. I was truly surprised when I accidentally ran the quick mode without detergent and the dishes came out so spotlessly clean. Noise: The noise level isn't as high as I thought, so running it late at night isn't a major issue. Convenience: I am very satisfied with the automatic door opening feature, which allows internal moisture to naturally escape after washing is complete. The drying performance is also excellent. Pros and Cons. Pros: It is easy to install and doesn't detract from the kitchen decor. Being able to load dishes immediately without bending over significantly reduces strain on my wrists and back! Cons: Due to its countertop nature, it does take up some counter space, but I consider this a minor issue compared to the joy of being freed from dishwashing. Overall Review. It is a lifesaver that dramatically improves my quality of life, making me wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy this?" I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to enhance their kitchen atmosphere and reduce housework time! If you like clean white appliances, you won't regret it. Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): [ Great design and performance! ] || ---------------- || Everyone who owns a dishwasher is satisfied and recommends it, so as someone who struggles with dishwashing, I deliberated for a long time before finally deciding to buy it. I made the decision after thoroughly researching various products, and it was truly an excellent choice. I had previously purchased a product, but the Coupang technician measured my kitchen size for free before installation. Since the size didn't fit, he recommended a product with a different size, so I canceled that order and repurchased it; I was very grateful for his kind assistance. (He mentioned that while the previously selected product could be installed, it didn't look good aesthetically.) The size of this new product was a perfect fit. The technician also kindly explained the installation and how to use the product. <Pros> 1. Hot Air Drying: After the automatic door opens, it draws in dry outside air and dries items once more with hot air. 'Moisture on plastic containers': No problem. 2. Storage: It offers ample storage space for a 14-place setting. The height of the top shelf is freely adjustable, so even if you place large frying pans or stockpots on the bottom, there is still plenty of storage space on the top shelf. The plate rack is easily detachable, making it ideal for efficiently arranging concave dishes like Korean tableware (rice bowls, soup bowls). 3. Low Noise. It is quiet enough that you won't be disturbed even if you run it late at night while watching TV or sleeping in the living room. 4. Water Softening System. It filters out limescale from tap water, preventing white water stains from remaining on glass cups or stainless steel pots. 5. Design. The matte beige tone characteristic of the Objet Collection blends seamlessly with any kitchen base cabinet, and it is easy to maintain as it resists fingerprints. <Cons>. 1. Electricity Costs and Time. Using the 'Hot Air Drying' option every time extends wash times and slightly increases electricity consumption. (Basic drying is possible without the hot air function). 2. Filter Maintenance. Food particles accumulating in the strainer can cause odors, so it should be lightly rinsed with water about once a week. (Applies to all dishwashers). I discard large food particles from the dishes and simply rinse them with water before putting them in. 3. Check Base Cabinet Size Before Installation. You need to check the size to see if it fits under base cabinets, such as under the baseboards. (A Coupang delivery driver confirmed this for me.) In conclusion, I am free from dishwashing! It is so convenient! I should have bought this sooner; I feel like I just hesitated for nothing. I highly recommend this product! If this was helpful in any way, please click "Helpful!" Thank you! ^-^

Comments (English): Rating: . Honestly, before buying the dishwasher, I wondered, "Is it really necessary?" but now I feel like I really couldn't live without it. You can live without a dryer, but a dishwasher is a true must-have. Once you use it, you will never go back to washing dishes by hand. For those who struggled with doing dishes every day, your quality of life will truly change. I am not exaggerating. It is the LG Dios Objet Collection, and after ordering, an LG representative visited in person the very next day to install it. These days, you often have to wait a long time after booking an installation, so it was great that they came the very next day. The installer was also incredibly kind. During the installation, they explained every single usage step and answered all my questions, so I was able to start the process on a positive note. However, there is one thing you absolutely must keep in mind! Since it is a built-in model, you must place a base plate on the bottom. I didn't know this at first but found out later; the base plate is essential for both floor protection and product stability. It would be better to prepare it in advance before installation. I wanted to write this down because I think quite a few people might install it without knowing this! The capacity is 12 place settings, so it is ample; there is plenty of room even after putting in all the pots and pans. The Nature Beige color matches my kitchen interior perfectly, and I am satisfied every time I look at the clean design signature of the Objet Collection. The cleaning power is better than expected, and the noise level is quieter than I thought. I have been using it without any issues since purchasing it. I highly recommend this to anyone looking for value for money, or those still debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher! Sentence (English): The LG dishwasher is currently the most satisfying household appliance I own.
Comments (English): The LG dishwasher is currently the most satisfying household appliance I own. I honestly wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I purchased the LG DIOS Objet Collection model, and the design matches my kitchen so well that I am quite satisfied with the interior aesthetics as well. First and foremost, the cleaning power—the most important factor—exceeds expectations. Even greasy frying pans and pots are cleaned thoroughly, and cups and glasses come out spotless without any water stains. I also appreciate that it uses high-temperature washing, which gives me peace of mind regarding hygiene. The advantages I have noticed while using it are as follows: Completely saves dishwashing time. I run it all at once once a day, and I can feel the amount of housework reduced significantly. My quality of life after work has changed dramatically. Quieter than expected noise. I was worried it might be loud at first, but it is quiet enough that it doesn't bother me even when running it at night. Satisfactory drying performance. Most items dry completely, although plastic containers do leave a little moisture (this is a common issue, so it is tolerable). Good storage space utilization. The internal structure is well-designed, so it holds more than expected. It is sufficient for a family of 3 to 4 people. Honestly, there are some downsides, though. Since installation space is limited, checking the dimensions beforehand is essential. It takes a little getting used to the way dishes are arranged at first. Consumables like detergent and rinse need to be managed. However, overall, the advantages far outweigh the disadvantages.
Comments (Original): 요즘 집안일 중에서 가장 만족도가 높은 가전이 바로 LG 식기세척기입니다. 진짜 왜 이제 샀나 싶을 정도네요.저는 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 식기세척기 모델로 구매했는데, 디자인부터가 주방이랑 너무 잘 어울려서 인테리어 만족도도 꽤 높습니다.우선 가장 중요한 세척력은 기대 이상입니다.기름기 많은 프라이팬이나 냄비도 말끔하게 세척되고, 컵이나 유리잔도 물자국 없이 깨끗하게 나옵니다. 특히 고온 세척이라 위생적으로 안심되는 부분도 좋습니다.사용하면서 느낀 장점은 다음과 같습니다.설거지 시간 완전 절약 하루에 한 번 몰아서 돌리는데, 체감상 집안일이 확 줄었습니다. 퇴근 후 삶의 질이 달라졌어요.소음이 생각보다 조용함 처음엔 시끄러울까 걱정했는데, 밤에 돌려도 크게 신경 쓰이지 않는 수준입니다.건조 성능 만족 대부분 뽀송하게 마르는데, 플라스틱 용기는 약간 물기 남는 정도는 있습니다 (이건 거의 공통적인 부분이라 감안 가능).적재 공간 활용 좋음 내부 구조가 잘 되어 있어서 생각보다 많이 들어갑니다. 3~4인 가족 기준으로 충분합니다.아쉬운 점도 솔직히 있습니다.설치 공간 제약이 있어서 사전에 사이즈 확인은 필수초반에는 식기 배치 방법 적응이 조금 필요함세제나 린스 등 소모품 관리 필요그래도 전체적으로 보면 단점보다 장점이 훨씬 큽니다.

Sentence (English): We love that this dishwasher is also so quiet!
Comments (English): [ Very quiet ] || ---------------- || We love that this dishwasher is also so quiet! All of the dishes get so clean. The reason for my lack of five stars is because too frequently as we are putting dishes in the lower rack, the rack comes off its guide, and we have to unload the bottom rack in order to get it back where it's supposed to be. I don't believe that this should happen just because we are pulling out that rack to place items in it. The other reason for three stars is the top rack is not very well organized. I have to figure out how to place most glasses so they're not banging into one another and the silverware holder along the side of the bottom rack frequently prevents the water arm from totally circling because a knife or a fork is tall. The very top rack is to be used for knives or any other utensils that doesn't need to be jostled around. Unfortunate thing is that when I place knives in there there is a buildup of something on the knives and the only way to get it off is to wash them all by hand. I no longer use that very top and it's a potentially very useful shelf.

가격대가 좀 있다고 느낄 수 있지만, 매일 설거지에 쏟던 긴 시간을 온전히 나를 위한 휴식으로 쓸 수 있다는 점을 생각하면 가성비는 최고라고 봅니다. 수도 사용량도 손 설거지보다 훨씬 적게 든다고 하니 장기적으로 보면 경제적인 면에서도 꽤 이득이더라고요. 빌트인 공사 없이도 삼성의 프리미엄 서비스를 누릴 수 있다는 점과 탄탄한 내구성을 고려하면, 한 번의 세척된 그릇들을 볼 때마다 이 제품을 사길 정말 잘했다는 생각이 절로 듭니다.공간 확보를 위한 약간의 고민사용하면서 느낀 점 중 굳이 하나를 꼽자면, 6인용 카운터탑 특성상 싱크대 위의 조리 공간을 일정 부분 차지한다는 점입니다. 하지만 이건 선반의 위치를 잘 조정하거나 주변 물건을 정리하면 충분히 해결 가능한 부분이었어요. 또한, 전용 세제를 사용해야 분싱크대 하부장 공사가 불가능하거나 부담스러워 고민이신 분주방 분위기를 살려주는 예쁘고 감각적인 가전을 찾으시는 분고온 살균과 자동 문 열림으로 위생적인 식기 관리를 원하시는 분컵이나 조리도구를 늘 청결하게 유지하고 싶은 1~2인 가구저는 사실 처음엔 반신반의하며 구매했었습니다. 6인용은 세척력이 약할 거라는 편견이 있었거든요. 그런데 막상 설치해서 써보니 가격대가 좀 있다고 느낄 수 있지만, 매일 설거지에 쏟던 긴 시간을 온전히 나를 위한 휴식으로 쓸 수 있다는 점을 생각하면 가성비는 최고라고 봅니다. 수도 사용량도 손 설거지보다 훨씬 적게 든다고 하니 장기적으로 보면 경제적인 면에서도 꽤 이득이더라고요. 빌트인 공사 없이도 삼성의 프리미엄 서비스를 누릴 수 있다는 점과 탄탄한 내구성을 고려하면, 한 번의 Another major advantage is that it is a countertop model, so it can be placed directly on the sink, minimizing the burden of installation. For me, as I was hesitant about major renovations due to my limited kitchen space, this was the perfect choice that blends seamlessly into the space without creating any visual clutter. Since it gives the kitchen a tidy impression every time I look at it, cooking and cleaning feel much more enjoyable and pleasant than before. Powerful cleaning that leaves dishes squeaky clean, even cleaner than hand washing. I was worried that the performance might be lacking since it is a 6-place setting model, but after actually using it, the power was stronger than I expected. The high-pressure water jets spraying from the upper and lower wings clean every nook and cranny of the dishes, effectively removing greasy pans used for cooking pork belly and stuck-on rice grains. In particular, using the high-temperature sterilization wash mode completely removes grease, leaving dishes squeaky clean to the touch. What I was most satisfied with was the automatic door opening feature. Once the wash is finished, the door opens on its own to release internal moisture, allowing for incredibly fast natural drying and eliminating any worries about unpleasant odors. Thanks to the efficient storage configuration that easily accommodates cooking utensils, cups, and even fairly large pots, I was completely freed from the stress of washing dishes for three meals a day. The noise level was also quieter than expected; it was quiet enough that I could operate it late at night without being bothered, allowing me to relax comfortably. It is the best lifestyle investment that saves time and effort. While the price might feel a bit high at first, considering that I can use the long hours I used to spend on dishwashing every day entirely for my own relaxation, I believe it offers the best value for money. Since it uses significantly less water than hand washing, it turned out to be quite economical in the long run. Considering the ability to enjoy Samsung's premium services without the need for built-in renovations and its robust durability, I felt the cost was absolutely worth it, as a single purchase essentially buys years of peace of mind. Its versatility is truly limitless, especially for single-person or two-person households or families with children, where it is highly useful for sterilizing baby bottles or washing cups. Thanks to its sturdy body and the brand's characteristic reliability and low breakdown rate, I expect to use it consistently for a long time, so I would strongly recommend it as a kitchen essential. Every morning when I see the dishes washed spotlessly, I find myself thinking how glad I am that I made the purchase. A slight concern regarding space management: if I had to pick one thing I noticed while using it, it is that due to its nature as a 6-person countertop, it takes up a certain amount of cooking space above the sink. However, this is easily resolvable by adjusting the shelf positions or organizing surrounding items. Also, it is worth keeping in mind that using the dedicated detergent ensures optimal cleaning performance. In fact, aside from these minor maintenance points, the product's overall quality is so high and its performance is so overwhelming that, as an actual user, there was nothing but praise to be found. You won't understand the refreshing feeling you get after washing dishes unless you experience it yourself. I recommend this to the following people: Those whose stress has reached its peak due to the repetitive task of washing dishes every day; those who are hesitant because remodeling their sink base cabinets is impossible or too burdensome; those looking for a pretty and stylish appliance that enhances their kitchen atmosphere; those who want hygienic dishware management through high-temperature sterilization and automatic door opening; and 1-2 person households who want to keep cups and cooking utensils clean at all times. However, after actually installing and using it, I felt my quality of life improve dramatically, and I am so satisfied that I want to buy an additional one immediately without hesitation! It handles cooking utensils and cups with ease and cleans them perfectly, making my time in the kitchen much more relaxed. If you want to escape the hell of dishwashing, try this product to reclaim your leisurely evenings. It will be a choice you truly won't regret!

라인이 돋보여서 주방 어디에 두어도 세련된 느낌을 주더라고요. 보통 식기세척기라고 하면 투박하고 거대한 느낌이 강하지만, 이 모델은 슬림하면서도 모던한 감성이 가득해서 마치 주방용 인테리어 소품을 놓은 듯한 기분이 듭니다.카운터탑 형태라 싱크대 위에 바로 올릴 수 있어 설치 부담이 적은 것도 큰 장점입니다. 주방 공간이 협소해서 대형 공사가 부담스러웠던 저에게는 시각적인 답답함 없이 공간에 아주 잘 어우러지는 완벽한 선택이었어요. 주방을 볼 때마다 정돈된 느낌을 주니까 요리하고 정리하는 시간이 전보다 훨씬 즐겁고 쾌적하게 느껴집니다.손 설거지보다 깨끗하고 뽀득뽀득한 강력 세척6인용이라 성능이 부족하지 않을까 걱정했지만, 실제 사용해 보니 기대 이상으로 파워가 강력했습니다. 상하 날개에서 뿜어져 나오는 고압 물줄기가 그릇 구석구석을 씻어내서, 기름기가 많은 삼겹살 팬이나 눌어붙은 밥알도 말끔하게 제거되더라고요. 특히 고온 살균 세척 모드를 사용하면 기름기가 완전히 제거되어 그릇을 만졌을 때 뽀득 소리가 날 정도로 청결해집니다.무엇보다 만족스러운 건 자동 문 열림 기능입니다. 세척이 끝나면 스스로 문이 열리면서 내부의 습기를 배출해 주니 자연 건조가 정말 빠르고 물 비린내 걱정도 전혀 없습니다. 조리도구나 컵 종류는 물론이고, 웬만한 크기의 냄비까지 거뜬하게 소화하는 효율적인 수납 구성 덕분에 하루 세 끼 설거지 스트레스에서 완벽하게 해방되었습니다. 소음도 생각보다 조용해서 밤늦게 작동시켜도 큰 신경이 쓰이지 않을 정도라 편안하게 휴식을 취할 수 있었습니다.시간과 노동력을 아껴주는 최고의 라이프 투자처음에는 가격대가 좀 있다고 느낄 수 있지만, 매일 설거지에 쏟던 긴 시간을 온전히 나를 위한 휴식으로 쓸 수 있다는 점을 생각하면 가성비는 최고라고 봅니다. 수도 사용량도 손 설거지보다 훨씬 적게 든다고 하니 장기적으로 보면 경제적인 면에서도 꽤 이득이더라고요. 빌트인 공사 없이도 삼성의 프리미엄 서비스를 누릴 수 있다는 점과 탄탄한 내구성을 고려하면, 한 번의 구매로 몇 년간의 여유를 사는 셈이라 비용이 전혀 아깝지 않았습니다.특히 1~2인 가구나 아이가 있는 집이라면 젖병 소독이나 컵 세척용으로도 활용도가 너무 높아서 활용 범위가 무궁무진합니다. 튼튼한 바디와 고장이 적은 브랜드 특유의 신뢰감 덕분에 오래도록 변함없이 잘 사용할 수 있을 듯하여 주방 필수 아이템으로 강력히 추천하고 싶습니다. 매일 아침 깨끗하게 세척된 그릇들을 볼 때마다 이 제품을 사길 정말 잘했다는 생각이 절로 듭니다.공간 확보를 위한 약간의 고민사용하면서 느낀 점 중 굳이 하나를 꼽자면, 6인용 카운터탑 특성상 싱크대 위의 조리 공간을 일정 부분 차지한다는 점입니다. 하지만 이건 선반의 위치를 잘 조정하거나 주변 물건을 정리하면 충분히 해결 가능한 부분이었어요. 또한, 전용 세제를 사용해야 최상의 세척력을 볼 수 있다는 점도 기억해 두시면 좋을 듯합니다. 사실 이런 사소한 관리 포인트 외에는 제품 자체의 완성도가 워낙 높고 성능이 압도적이라 실사용자 입장에서는 칭찬할 내용밖에 없었습니다. 설거지 후에 느껴지는 그 개운함은 직접 경험해 보지 않으면 모르실 거예요.이런 분들에게 추천합니다매일 반복되는 설거지 업무 때문에 스트레스가 극에 달하신 분싱크대 하부장 공사가 불가능하거나 부담스러워 고민이신 분주방 분위기를 살려주는 예쁘고 감각적인 가전을 찾으시는 분고온 살균과 자동 문 열림으로 위생적인 식기 관리를 원하시는 분컵이나 조리도구를 늘 청결하게 유지하고 싶은 1~2인 가구저는 사실 처음엔 반신반의하며 구매했었습니다. 6인용은 세척력이 약할 거라는 편견이 있었거든요. 그런데 막상 설치해서 써보니 삶의 질이 확 올라가는 게 느껴져서 고민도 안 하고 바로 추가로 구매하고 싶을 만큼 만족하고 있습니다! 조리도구나 컵 정도는 정말 거뜬하게 버텨주고 깨끗해지니까 주방에 있는 시간이 훨씬 여유로워졌답니다. 설거지옥에서 벗어나고 싶으시다면, 이 제품으로 여유로운 저녁 시간을 되찾아보세요. 정말 후회 없는 선택이 되실 겁니다!

가격대가 좀 있다고 느낄 수 있지만, 매일 설거지에 쏟던 긴 시간을 온전히 나를 위한 휴식으로 쓸 수 있다는 점을 생각하면 가성비는 최고라고 봅니다. 수도 사용량도 손 설거지보다 훨씬 적게 든다고 하니 장기적으로 보면 경제적인 면에서도 꽤 이득이더라고요. 빌트인 공사 없이도 삼성의 프리미엄 서비스를 누릴 수 있다는 점과 탄탄한 내구성을 고려하면, 한 번의 구매로 몇 년간의 여유를 사는 셈이라 비용이 전혀 아깝지 않았습니다.특히 1~2인 가구나 아이가 있는 집이라면 젖병 소독이나 컵 세척용으로도 활용도가 너무 높아서 활용 범위가 무궁무진합니다. 튼튼한 바디와 고장이 적은 브랜드 특유의 신뢰감 덕분에 오래도록 변함없이 잘 사용할 수 있을 듯하여 주방 필수 아이템으로 강력히 추천하고 싶습니다. 매일 아침 깨끗하게 세척된 그릇들을 볼 때마다 이 제품을 사길 정말 잘했다는 생각이 절로 듭니다.공간 확보를 위한 약간의 고민사용하면서 느낀 점 중 굳이 하나를 꼽자면, 6인용 카운터탑 특성상 싱크대 위의 조리 공간을 일정 부분 차지한다는 점입니다. 하지만 이건 선반의 위치를 잘 조정하거나 주변 물건을 정리하면 충분히 해결 가능한 부분이었어요. 또한, 전용 세제를 사용해야 Sentence (English): After our 13yo GE crumped out, we bought this from Costco and had it installed in early March by the costco contracted installers.
Comments (English): [ Fixable ] || ---------------- || After our 13yo GE crumped out, we bought this from Costco and had it installed in early March by the costco contracted installers. The installers (Tabuso Plumbing) did a fine job, despite which our new washing machine only functioned for a couple days before giving a leak error. The leak error was associated with an intermittent "sucking" sound (more audible with the machine door open) and the refusal of the machine to power off (hitting the power button would turn the machine off, but it would turn itself back on, restarting the sucking sound and the leak error alerts; we had to unplug the machine to keep it powered off).The installers would not return to check out the leak error (they are not contracted to do so), BUT Samsung customer service sent out service technicians within a week, diagnosed a faulty water pump, and replaced it. Since then, we've had no problems.Given the description of problems written by others within this review thread, it appears that a faulty water pump is a common problem with these units, but it appears to be easily fixed if diagnosed correctly.I am currently satisfied with the function and appearance (white glass) of the machine and would buy it again. Would recommend that others buy if they're willing to tolerate the significant potential for a delay caused by a faulty -but fixable- part.If you have a low frustration tolerance, you may want to look elsewhere. but honestly, there doesn't appear to be much on the market (at this point) that has a superior track record for reliability.

Sentence (English): I picked up this Samsung dishwasher mainly because the price made sense, and honestly, for what I needed, it does the job pretty well.
Comments (English): [ Great Price for a good product ] || ---------------- || I picked up this Samsung dishwasher mainly because the price made sense, and honestly, for what I needed, it does the job pretty well. The biggest thing I noticed right away is how quiet it is. It's not completely silent, but compared to older dishwashers I've used, it's a big improvement—you can actually run it without it being distracting.For everyday loads, it performs just fine. Plates, glasses, utensils—no issues there as long as you're not throwing in stuff with heavy, baked-on messes. It feels like it's built more for normal, day-to-day use rather than tackling really tough cleaning jobs.The adjustable rack is a nice touch too. It makes it easier to fit bigger items when needed, which I didn't realize I'd appreciate as much as I do.That said, the drying could definitely be better. Dishes—especially plastic—sometimes come out a bit damp, so I've had to get used to letting things air dry or wiping a few items down. Also, the overall build feels decent, but not premium. You can tell it's more of a budget-friendly model.Overall, I'd say it's a solid choice if you're looking for something affordable, quiet, and reliable for regular use. Just don't expect top-tier drying or heavy-duty performance, and you'll probably be satisfied. Lastly easy install for all the DIY'ers!

This dishwasher does an amazing job at cleaning our dishes. So for that I highly recommend. However, it does have a few frustrating "features". The racks are difficult to use for a number of reasons. In the two months I've been using my machine, I still don't know the best way to load it. The top rack is OK (not great) but the bottom rack is bad. You can't put anything in the front half of the rack between the tines because everytime you push the rack in the dishes fall towards the back. I love having the flex tray at the top but the handle design is terrible and it is always coming loose. And on all the racks the tines that you can lay down never want to stay in place. The control panel has bright LED lights but the icons aren't lit up, which means at night when you want to use the machine you can't see the buttons because you're blinded by bright white light bars. Lastly, I put the machine online, which was handy for setting up washing cycles, but the other day it mysteriously disconnected from my phone and now I can't get the machine back online again.

Since it’s the LG Dios Objet Collection, the design is clean and blends well with my kitchen decor, making it look great. Most importantly, I chose it without hesitation because the performance was good for the price, but using it actually exceeded my expectations, so I’m even more satisfied! The most satisfying aspect of using it is definitely the cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and pots come out clean without needing extensive pre-washing, which has significantly reduced my dishwashing stress. It’s especially convenient because the capacity allows me to wash a whole day's worth of dishes at once. I was also worried about whether it would be okay without a hot air drying function, but perhaps because of the automatic door opening feature, the moisture naturally drains after the wash, allowing the dishes to dry thoroughly. It took longer than anticipated because additional work was required depending on the house structure, but the LG technician was very kind, explained everything thoroughly, and finished the job neatly, so that was a plus. I think it would be much easier if you checked the sink layout and space beforehand before installation. Also, arranging the dishes might be a little confusing at first, but you'll get used to it quickly after using it a few times! Overall, I feel like this product offers excellent performance for its price. I am satisfied with its cleaning power, convenience, and design, with no major shortcomings. Thanks to the automatic door opening feature, drying is also hassle-free, so I am very satisfied with actual use. I think it would be especially suitable for those new to dishwashers or those looking for a good value product. I highly recommend it! :) + I use 'Poshong All-in-One Powder' detergent. Sentence (English): I looked into built-in dishwashers to keep my kitchen tidy after moving, and I ended up choosing a Samsung BESPOKE model; it turned out to be a purchase I am extremely satisfied with.
Comments (English): [ My dishwashing lady ] || ---------------- || I looked into built-in dishwashers to keep my kitchen tidy after moving, and I ended up choosing a Samsung BESPOKE model; it turned out to be a purchase I am extremely satisfied with. First of all, since it has a large capacity of 14 place settings, I can load a lot of dishes at once, so it is more than sufficient for family use. Pots and pans fit comfortably inside, so the frequency of washing dishes has definitely decreased. The cleaning power was better than expected; it cleanly removes greasy dishes and burnt-on food, so I rarely need to wash dishes by hand anymore. I particularly liked that it includes a sterilization function, allowing for hygienic use. I think it would be very satisfying for households with children or anyone who is concerned about hygiene. The drying function was also very satisfying; since it uses a hot air drying method, I liked that dishes finish fresh and dry without any moisture. With the automatic door opening feature, internal moisture is naturally released, reducing concerns about odors and ensuring a pleasant environment at all times. True to the BESPOKE line, the design is very clean and sophisticated; it doesn't detract from the kitchen interior but actually enhances it to look more luxurious. Being a built-in type, it maximizes space utilization, and overall, the kitchen feels much more organized. Furthermore, since installation was handled directly by Samsung via direct delivery and finished neatly by a professional, I didn't have to worry about anything. The reliable after-sales support is also a major advantage. Overall, this product satisfies all aspects—time saving, hygiene, and design—to the point where once you use it, it's hard to go back to not having it. I highly recommend this to anyone looking to reduce their dishwashing stress.
Comments (Original): [ 우리집 설거지 이모님 ] || ---------------- || 이사하면서 주방을 깔끔하게 정리하고 싶어서 빌트인 식기세척기를 알아보다가 삼성 BESPOKE 제품으로 선택했는데, 결과적으로 정말 만족도가 높은 구매였습니다. 우선 14인용 대용량이라 한 번에 많은 식기를 넣을 수 있어서 가족 단위 사용에도 전혀 부족함이 없어요. 냄비나 프라이팬까지 여유 있게 들어가서 설거지 횟수가 확실히 줄었습니다.세척력도 기대 이상이었는데, 기름기 많은 그릇이나 눌어붙은 음식도 깨끗하게 잘 제거돼서 손설거지할 필요가 거의 없어졌어요. 특히 살균 기능이 포함되어 있어서 위생적으로 사용할 수 있다는 점이 마음에 들었습니다. 아이 있는 집이나 위생 신경 쓰시는 분들께도 충분히 만족스러울 것 같아요.건조 기능도 굉장히 만족스러웠는데, 열풍건조 방식이라 물기 없이 뽀송하게 마무리되는 점이 좋았습니다. 자동문 열림 기능까지 있어서 내부 습기까지 자연스럽게 배출되니 냄새 걱정도 줄어들고, 항상 쾌적하게 사용할 수 있어요.디자인 역시 BESPOKE 라인답게 굉장히 깔끔하고 세련된 느낌이라 주방 인테리어를 해치지 않고 오히려 더 고급스럽게 만들어줍니다. 빌트인 타입이라 공간 활용도도 뛰어나고, 전체적으로 주방이 훨씬 정돈된 느낌이 들어요.또 설치도 삼성 직배송으로 진행돼서 전문가가 깔끔하게 마무리해주니 별도로 신경 쓸 부분이 없었고, A/S까지 안정적으로 지원된다는 점도 큰 장점입니다.전체적으로 시간 절약, 위생, 디자인까지 모두 만족시키는 제품이라 한 번 사용하면 없던 시절로 돌아가기 힘들 정도예요. 설거지 스트레스 줄이고 싶은 분들께 정말 강력하게 추천드립니다
