Sentence (English): I've been using this dishwasher daily for over 3months.
Comments (English): [ Amazing on paper but cleaning ability is a let dow ] || ---------------- || I've been using this dishwasher daily for over 3months. I have many opinions about it, good and bad. Overall I am disappointed. On paper, this dishwasher has many features that I feel like is a significant improvement to my older dishwasher. Thing such as their QuadWash pro & true steam that is supposed to be more cleaning power. In practice, it does not clean well at all. I don't understand why it doesn't clean as well. I see a lot of spouts for water jets. Way more than I am used to. I don't know if the jet isn't as strong or perhaps the locations and rack design aren't optimize, or a mix of both reasons. I've used the normal cycle daily for a family of 5, which takes about 2h15min to complete, there would always be dirty dishes remaining. To resolve this issue, I noticed that I would have to prewash or use the heavy cycle instead to have proper cleaning of my dishes. The heavy cycle takes over 4hrs. I've been using this set up for over a month now and have no more issues with dirty dishes. For the cost of the machine, this is a big problem no matter now many other fancy features it has. Second major issue I have with this dishwasher is the design of the racks. It looks very spacious and well designed. However, in practice, it's very easy to overcrowd with my normal amounts of dishes. I think this is due to the spacing between the dividers. The top rack for utensils, especially, is amazing on paper but terrible in reality. The spacers are tiny. Only fits certain types of utensils. My family uses chopsticks. It has no appropriate space to accommodate a large number of chopsticks. This also includes straws or utensils for babies and toddlers because of their thicker handles. While I can use the basket for these utensils, I don't like using it because the rack is not actually spacious due to the design and overcrowding in situations of non-optimal dish placement. One last issue i had with this dishwasher is the installation. Overall, it was not too difficult. My husband is very handy so it was straightforward for him. However, the instructions manual had missing information and we had to purchase extra supplies not included. The cables did not come with any plug for the electric outlet. Even though the image is clear, the manual did not list it. This is a minor issue. So buyers be aware. Now on to features that I do love. Firstly and most importantly, the dynamic heat dry with autovent. Gone are the days of wet plastic dishes after cleaning cycle. I don't have to be there to vent the door at night. The dishes are always dry no matter the material (unless it was overcrowded). I also appreciate the ability to control the dishwasher using the ThinQ app. I always forget to turn on the washer before going to bed. Now if I did forget, I can start it at the comfort of my bed. This is a small quality of life improvement that is not always useful or appreciated by people who do not care for technology or worry about safety. I enjoy it. There are many other small features that are nice but are so minor that I won't list them all to avoid a huge wall of text. It's beautiful with a sleek design. I think if it wasn't for the first two issues I listed, I think this dishwasher would absolutely worth it. Fortunately for me, I got this dishwasher with a large discount so I'm not regretting it. But for a consumer who will be paying for it at full price, I do not recommend.

So it's obvious Whirlpool is just going to squirm out of any warrantee claims if they can.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Amazing on paper but cleaning ability is a let dow ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I've been using this dishwasher daily for over 3months. I have many opinions about it, good and bad. Overall I am disappointed. On paper, this dishwasher has many features that I feel like is a significant improvement to my older dishwasher. Thing such as their QuadWash pro & true steam that is supposed to be more cleaning power. In practice, it does not clean well at all. I don't understand why it doesn't clean as well. I see a lot of spouts for water jets. Way more than I am used to. I don't know if the jet isn't as strong or perhaps the locations and rack design aren't optimize, or a mix of both reasons. I've used the normal cycle daily for a family of 5, which takes about 2h15min to complete, there would always be dirty dishes remaining. To resolve this issue, I noticed that I would have to prewash or use the heavy cycle instead to have proper cleaning of my dishes. The heavy cycle takes over 4hrs. I've been using this set up for over a month now and have no more issues with dirty dishes. For the cost of the machine, this is a big problem no matter now many other fancy features it has. Second major issue I have with this dishwasher is the design of the racks. It looks very spacious and well designed. However, in practice, it's very easy to overcrowd with my normal amounts of dishes. I think this is due to the spacing between the dividers. The top rack for utensils, especially, is amazing on paper but terrible in reality. The spacers are tiny. Only fits certain types of utensils. My family uses chopsticks. It has no appropriate space to accommodate a large number of chopsticks. This also includes straws or utensils for babies and toddlers because of their thicker handles. While I can use the basket for these utensils, I don't like using it because the rack is not actually spacious due to the design and overcrowding in situations of non-optimal dish placement. One last issue i had with this dishwasher is the installation. Overall, it was not too difficult. My husband is very handy so it was straightforward for him. However, the instructions manual had missing information and we had to purchase extra supplies not included. The cables did not come with any plug for the electric outlet. Even though the image is clear, the manual did not list it. This is a minor issue. So buyers be aware. Now on to features that I do love. Firstly and most importantly, the dynamic heat dry with autovent. Gone are the days of wet plastic dishes after cleaning cycle. I don't have to be there to vent the door at night. The dishes are always dry no matter the material (unless it was overcrowded). I also appreciate the ability to control the dishwasher using the ThinQ app. I always forget to turn on the washer before going to bed. Now if I did forget, I can start it at the comfort of my bed. This is a small quality of life improvement that is not always useful or appreciated by people who do not care for technology or worry about safety. I enjoy it. There are many other small features that are nice but are so minor that I won't list them all to avoid a huge wall of text. It's beautiful with a sleek design. I think if it wasn't for the first two issues I listed, I think this dishwasher would absolutely worth it. Fortunately for me, I got this dishwasher with a large discount so I'm not regretting it. But for a consumer who will be paying for it at full price, I do not recommend.

I highly recommend it :) ! + I use 'Poshong All-in-One Powder' detergent~ It is a Class 1 detergent, and it cleans well even without rinse aid !

I think it would be especially suitable for those new to dishwashers or those looking for a good value product. I highly recommend it :) ! + I use 'Poshong All-in-One Powder' detergent~ It is a Class 1 detergent, and it cleans well even without rinse aid !
